description: Looks up one MITRE ATT&CK technique (e.g. T1059 or T1059.001) on its official public page: its name, the tactic-level summary text and the page title. Reads one page per call; it does not return the whole matrix or a technique's sub-techniques list. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

technique.description: ATT&CK technique ID such as T1059 or T1059.001 (required)
